title: material.measurement.v1
description: A measured quantity of material at a stage of the gold circuit (ore→crusher→mill→tanks→carbon→furnace→output→gate). The ingestion groundwork for gold reconciliation (FP-09): measurements are recorded with source provenance so downstream slices can compute expected-vs-observed variance. This contract carries only MEASURED inputs; it never asserts an expectation, a variance, or a theft conclusion. See docs/feature-plans/GOLD_RECONCILIATION.md.

measurement_id.description: Deterministic id so replay/backfill of the same measurement is idempotent.

stage.description: Where in the circuit the measurement was taken.

unit.description: Unit of quantity, e.g. t, kg, g.

assay_ref.description: Reference to a laboratory.result.v1 assay (FP-08), when applicable.

quality.description: Source quality/status flag, when the source provides one.

source.description: Where the measurement came from, e.g. weightometer, crusher_scale, production, manual, import.

provenance.description: This record carries a measured quantity, not an estimate or an expectation.
